facts.offer: Credit redemption rules; not a currently verified offer
facts.conditions: A valid account is required. Redeem a code or follow DigitalOcean's instructions. Each code is redeemable once on one account; eligibility and expiry depend on the specific offer.
facts.label: Promotional credit terms

facts.offer: Eligible charges and usage beyond credit
facts.conditions: Only designated services qualify. Marketplace, Support, upfront payments and taxes are excluded. Usage exceeding available credit is billed; combining incentives requires authorization.
facts.label: Credit exclusions and billing

facts.conditions: DigitalOcean says it does not offer refunds. Contact support about extenuating circumstances; this is not a refund guarantee.
facts.label: Official refund policy

faq.question: Is there a verified DigitalOcean promo code here?
faq.answer: No public code was verified in the official pages reviewed. General credit terms do not establish a currently available offer or a particular credit amount.

faq.question: How would I redeem an official credit?
faq.answer: Follow the instructions supplied by DigitalOcean for the particular offer, and check its eligibility and expiry before using resources.

faq.question: Can I get a refund?
faq.answer: The official support page says refunds are not offered and directs customers with extenuating circumstances to support.
